headline: French Protests Lose Momentum as Turnout Drops 85% Over Six Weeks
summary: Protests across France entered their sixth week with significantly reduced participation, down 85% since October 17. Trade unions have scheduled a new nationwide strike for December 1.
why: Labor unrest and general strikes in France disrupt national logistics, transportation networks, and retail activity.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Declining protest participation reduces immediate nationwide logistical and business disruptions.
